show.description: Five years after being humiliated, disowned, and divorced, Yatin Kothari returns to his daughter’s birthday as a nobody. But beneath his modest exterior lies a secret—he is Chanakya, the anonymous mastermind behind billion-dollar empires. As his ex-wife, former family, and rivals mock him, Yatin exposes his true identity, topples the powerful Kotharis, and shocks everyone. But a devastating claim about his daughter’s paternity threatens to destroy everything he fought to reclaim.
